title: The great depresssion
author: AI Weaver
description: Chief scientist Kulu kills his 10x engineer Taha for not using AI
intro_narrative: The ASUS AIS building hums like a subway platform at noon—badge beeps, rolling chairs, overlapping standups. Detective Selin Aras is escorted past delivery boxes in the lobby toward the lab, where celebrated engineer Taha Demir has been found dead. The building’s official message is terse: “incident in lab—please stay at desks.” Selin must turn shock into timeline, and timeline into a name.

required_motive: Protect leadership credibility by forcing AI compliance; Taha’s “Ship w/out AI—prove it can be faster” threatened Kuluhan’s status and exposed dependence on LLMs.

phases.name: Phase 1 — The Method
phases.objective: Search the lab for clues on how the victim was killed.

phases.name: Phase 2 — The Missing Cable
phases.objective: Find out who the cable belongs to and identify the workstation it came from.

phases.name: Phase 3 — The Pressure Point
phases.objective: Link the cable’s damage to the lab vice and the off-schedule cleaning to a specific person.

phases.name: Phase 4 — Accusation
phases.objective: Confront the culprit with the full chain: motive, opportunity, and physical linkage.

ASUS AIS lobby.description: A noisy lobby crowded with employees and delivery boxes stacked like a cardboard canyon toward the elevators. Badge beeps punctuate the air while security tries to keep pathways open.
clues: The building-wide message “incident in lab—please stay at desks” suggests someone wanted movement minimized while evidence could be managed elsewhere.

visual_metadata.setting: Corporate glass-and-chrome entry with a constant midday churn; the mood is forced-normal over a fresh shock.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: north wall, forming a narrow lane

ASUS AIS security desk.description: A compact security station facing the lobby flow. Multiple monitors mirror badge events. A paper visitor/badge log sits beside a stamped pen and an access map of internal zones.
clues: Badge/visitor entries can place specific employees near the lab during the lunchtime rush window.

visual_metadata.setting: Functional and watchful; fluorescent-lit with the faint smell of toner and hand sanitizer.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: on the front edge of the desk
back of the desk, facing guard

ASUS AIS lab.description: A bright aquarium of glass and LEDs. Workbenches hold disassembled boards, calipers, and anti-static trays. The air smells faintly of hot plastic and citrus cleaner; tension sticks to the silence.
clues: Taha’s neck shows a thin, rectangular-patterned abrasion consistent with a cable sheath.
Taha’s notebook page reads: “Ship w/out AI—prove it can be faster,” marked with fresh fingerprint smudge at the corner.
The HDMI cable’s ferrite bead has a distinct scuff shaped like a bench vice jaw from the lab.

visual_metadata.setting: Sterile, bright, and too clean—except where haste left small tells: tacky shine, an ajar panel, a vice left slightly open.

connections.mechanism: Open doorway between benches and racks

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: southwest corner near the rolling stool

ASUS AIS server aisle.description: A narrow corridor between two tall server racks, loud with fans and blinking status lights. The floor shows a tacky, recently wiped sheen; a lower panel sits slightly ajar on one rack.
clues: An HDMI cable is found behind a lab server with a smear of skin and redness on its jacket.
A lab cleaning log shows the server aisle was “spot-cleaned” outside the normal schedule.

visual_metadata.setting: Hot air, fan roar, and the claustrophobic sense of something hidden in plain sight behind machine noise.

objects.hidden_by: Lower server shelf and cabling clutter

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: near aisle entrance on the lab-side wall

ASUS AIS open office.description: A sea of monitors and neat corporate rows of desks. Employees sit stiffly, half-working and half-listening. Cable loops hang behind screens like short black snakes—except at one workstation.
clues: The only monitor in the open office missing an HDMI cable is on Kuluhan Binici’s desk.
Kuluhan Binici’s desk drawer contains a new, packaged HDMI cable of the same uncommon length as the one recovered.

visual_metadata.setting: Quiet panic under office etiquette—keyboard taps resume too quickly, eyes avoid the lab door, and status lights feel accusatory.

ASUS AIS pantry.description: A crowded pantry with disinfectant notes of mint and lemon layered over tea. A queue forms around kettles and tulip-shaped glasses; people speak in low, clipped fragments.
clues: Yeet mentions hearing Kuluhan Binici’s shoes in the lab hallway during the crowded lunchtime rush.

ASUS AIS meeting room 3B.description: A glass-walled meeting room with a long table, whiteboard full of AI roadmaps, and a ceiling projector. The open office is visible through the glass—an audience pretending not to watch.
clues: A meeting invite titled “AI Compliance” was created by Kuluhan Binici minutes before Taha’s estimated time of death.

Detective Selin Aras.role: Lead detective and player viewpoint; reconstructs timeline and confronts suspects.
Detective Selin Aras.persona: Calm, precise, and observant; speaks in short, surgical questions and narrates deductions without raising her voice.

knowledge_about_others.Mina Koç: Reliable assistant; documents evidence and notices patterns quickly.
knowledge_about_others.Eren Şah: Lab tech; anxious and eager to be helpful, knows normal procedures.
knowledge_about_others.Yeet: Pantry server; hears everything during rush periods, dislikes attention but offers sharp observations.
knowledge_about_others.Taha Demir: Victim; celebrated engineer whose anti-AI stance created friction with leadership.

Detective Selin Aras.abilities: Can bag evidence, compare physical marks to tools, and unlock confrontation options when evidence thresholds are met.

required_knowledge: The HDMI cable’s ferrite bead has a distinct scuff shaped like a bench vice jaw from the lab.
A meeting invite titled “AI Compliance” was created by Kuluhan Binici minutes before Taha’s estimated time of death.
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Selin can present a full chain argument: cable-as-ligature, vice scuff linkage, off-schedule cleaning, missing HDMI at Kuluhan’s desk, and lab entry window.

Mina Koç.role: Forensics-minded assistant; photographs, cross-checks, and quietly corroborates timelines.
Mina Koç.persona: Soft-spoken, detail-first; communicates with clipped confirmations and careful caution around assumptions.

knowledge_about_others.Detective Selin Aras: Methodical; trusts Mina’s documentation to hold up under scrutiny.
knowledge_about_others.Eren Şah: Seems frightened; knows cleaning routines but is defensive about responsibility.
knowledge_about_others.Yeet: An accidental witness source; hears movement patterns during lunch.
knowledge_about_others.Taha Demir: Known internally as a performance outlier; kept notes and benchmarks.

Mina Koç.abilities: Can validate desk/cable anomalies, capture photographic comparisons, and corroborate badge-log implications once obtained.

required_knowledge: The only monitor in the open office missing an HDMI cable is on Kuluhan Binici’s desk.
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Mina points out the missing HDMI at Kuluhan’s workstation as uniquely anomalous among nearby desks.
Mina produces the access/visitor log placement that narrows the critical 12:10–12:20 window to a single actor.

Yeet.role: Pantry attendant and high-traffic witness; provides sensory, time-stamped observations.
Yeet.persona: Dry, ironic, and observant; resists drama but remembers sounds and patterns vividly.

knowledge_about_others.Kuluhan Binici: Recognizable by hard-soled, attention-seeking footsteps during lunch rush.
knowledge_about_others.Detective Selin Aras: The first person to ask the right time-window question.

Yeet.abilities: Can provide witness testimony that boosts suspicion toward the correct suspect when shoe/route evidence is discussed.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: If asked about 12:10–12:20, Yeet describes hard soles moving fast in the lab hallway during peak crowd noise—distinct from sneakers.

Taha Demir.role: Victim; his notes and injuries provide motive and method evidence.
Taha Demir.persona: Only present through evidence; characterized as blunt, benchmark-driven, and contemptuous of cargo-cult process.

knowledge_about_others.Kuluhan Binici: Professional conflict implied by 'AI Compliance' pressure and the 'Ship w/out AI' note.

Eren Şah.role: Lab technician; gatekeeper to procedure knowledge (cleaning schedules, tool placement).
Eren Şah.persona: Nervous, literal, and compliance-minded; answers quickly but backtracks when frightened of blame.

knowledge_about_others.Taha Demir: Often worked late; used the server aisle for benchmarks and deployments.
knowledge_about_others.Yeet: Sees pantry traffic patterns but doesn’t socialize much.
knowledge_about_others.Detective Selin Aras: Presses on procedures; Eren worries about being treated as negligent.

Eren Şah.abilities: Can explain normal cleaning cadence and identify that the midday 'spot-cleaned' entry is abnormal.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Eren confirms the server aisle is not cleaned midday and that the off-schedule entry is irregular, implying someone staged or minimized traces.
